result.title: SteinPnP: Non-Parametric Uncertainty Quantification in the Perspective-N-Point Problem
result.summary: We propose SteinPnP, a probabilistic Perspective- N-Point (PnP) solver that models the full 6-DoF camera pose posterior using a non-parametric set of pose particles. By lever- aging Stein Variational Inference (SVI), SteinPnP combines the expressivity of particle-based representations with the efficiency of optimization-based solvers. However, a naive application of SVI struggles in the PnP problem, often missing alternative pose hypotheses or assigning incorrect probability weights to them. To address these limitations, we propose practical remedies that discover new potential poses, identify distinct hypothesis clusters, and balance their relative probability weights to capture the true underlying distribution. Our experiments across synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that SteinPnP accurately captures complex multimodal uncertainties while maintaining competitive accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SteinPnP，一种用非参数位姿粒子集合经 Stein 变分推断建模完整 6-DoF 相机位姿后验的概率 PnP 求解器，并针对漏掉备选位姿、假设聚类与权重失配问题给出改进措施。
AI.relevance_reason: 以粒子集合保持多模态假设并显式聚类与平衡权重的思路，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的并行维持、证据筛选与置信度分配提供概念借鉴，但对象是几何位姿估计而非 VLM 推理，迁移性待核查。
